prompt: Use case: product-mockup. ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese bamboo/rattan catalog product. Subject: three-step counter display with plain wood platforms, empty product recesses and woven risers; front steps ascend, side reveals stair geometry, rear smooth bound woven panel. Style Boho: organic graceful curves and restrained craft detail. Relative size generous within its class. Principal weave regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions, finish cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Smooth bound joints, continuous strips, stable bamboo/wood supports and only described plain secondary materials. Interiors empty. CAMERA exact front elevation azimuth0, directly facing described front, level with product center, no overhead or three-quarter angle. Full product centered with generous margins, warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft light/subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture, square. Canonical front for other views. No props, signs, cards, sample goods, room, people, animals, plants, food, extra products, collage or diagram. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no letters, numbers, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, symbols, inscriptions or measurements.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
